description: Creates a website in the organization. Provide either a `name` (trimmed, 1–200 characters) or a creation `prompt`; a prompt returns immediately with the temporary name `Untitled site`, which the built-in naming request attempts to replace on its next run together with a matching available slug and platform hostname. The hostname receives a short suffix when the clean hostname is unavailable. An omitted `slug` is allocated from the initial name; an explicit slug must be lowercase, URL-safe, unreserved, and unique among active websites in the organization. The website starts as an unpublished draft at `headVersion` 1. Send an `idempotencyKey` to make retries return the same website. Edit its source through the Source code operations, then publish with `websiteSourceCode.head.publish`.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated key, such as a UUID, that makes creation safe to retry. Send the same key on every retry of one creation attempt: when this organization already has a website created with the key, that website is returned and no second website is created. A key whose website is in the trash returns a 409 with `idempotencyKeyStatus: "deleted"`; retry with a new key.

name: websites_create
title: Create a website
